Package index

Overview

psychnets psychnets-package
psychnets: Psychometric Network Estimation
psychnet()
Estimate a psychometric network with any of the package's estimators

Gaussian graphical models

Partial-correlation networks for continuous or ordinal indicators, regularized, selected stepwise, or nonparanormal.

ebic_glasso()
Estimate a Gaussian graphical model with the EBIC graphical lasso
ggm_modselect()
Select an unregularized Gaussian graphical model by stepwise search
pcor_network()
Estimate a partial correlation network
cor_network()
Estimate a correlation network
huge_network()
Estimate a nonparanormal Gaussian graphical model

Information-filtering and relative-importance networks

Sparse networks built from the correlation structure (TMFG, LoGo) and networks of shared explained variance.

tmfg_network()
Filter a correlation network with the triangulated maximally filtered graph
logo_network()
Estimate a sparse Gaussian graphical model on a filtered graph (LoGo)
relimp_network()
Estimate a directed relative-importance network

Binary and mixed data

Ising networks for binary indicators and mixed graphical models for variables of different types, including moderation.

ising_fit()
Estimate a regularized Ising network for binary items
ising_sampler()
Estimate an unregularized Ising network for binary items
mgm_fit()
Estimate a mixed graphical model for continuous and binary variables
condition() as.data.frame(<psychnet_moderated>) print(<psychnet_moderated>)
Read a moderated mixed graphical model at a value of the moderator
dichotomize()
Split numeric items into binary 0/1 variables

Panel and within-person networks

Temporal, contemporaneous and between-person networks from repeated measurements.

panel_gvar()
Estimate temporal, contemporaneous and between-person networks from panel data
as.data.frame(<psychnet_panelgvar>) print(<psychnet_panelgvar>) summary(<psychnet_panelgvar>) plot(<psychnet_panelgvar>)
Read the networks, parameters and fit of a panel graphical VAR
print(<psychnet_multilevel>) as.data.frame(<psychnet_multilevel>) summary(<psychnet_multilevel>) plot(<psychnet_multilevel>)
Within-actor and between-actor networks from event data

Groups and event data

One network per group, and networks from logs of coded events.

print(<psychnet_group>) as.data.frame(<psychnet_group>) summary(<psychnet_group>)
Networks estimated separately for each group
print(<psychnet_result_group>) as.data.frame(<psychnet_result_group>)
Results of an analysis applied to networks per group
event_frequencies()
Count the actions of each actor and session in an event log

Preparing data

cor_auto()
Compute correlations suited to ordinal and continuous variables
redundancy() print(<psychnet_redundancy>)
Detect redundant pairs of items
net_aggregate()
Aggregate communities of items into a network between communities

Node and network measures

net_centralities() plot(<psychnet_centrality>)
Compute the centrality of each node in a network
net_bridge() plot(<psychnet_bridge>)
Compute bridge centrality between communities of nodes
net_edge_betweenness()
Compute the edge betweenness of a network
net_clustering()
Compute weighted clustering coefficients of the nodes
net_smallworld()
Compute the small-world index of a network
net_predict()
Compute how well each node is predicted by the network
node_predictability()
Return node predictability as a vector for plotting

Accuracy and stability

Bootstrap intervals, difference tests, and the stability and reliability of edges and centralities under case dropping and splitting.

net_boot() as.data.frame(<psychnet_bootstrap>) print(<psychnet_bootstrap>) plot(<psychnet_bootstrap>)
Bootstrap the edges and centralities of a network
difference_test() plot(<psychnet_difference>)
Test differences between edges or between centralities within a network
plot(<psychnet_stability>) net_stability() print(<psychnet_stability>) as.data.frame(<psychnet_stability>)
Assess the stability of centralities when cases are dropped
net_casedrop_reliability() print(<psychnet_casedrop>) plot(<psychnet_casedrop>)
Assess the stability of edge weights when cases are dropped
net_split_reliability() print(<psychnet_reliability>) plot(<psychnet_reliability>)
Assess the split-half reliability of a network's edge weights

Comparing networks

net_compare() summary(<psychnet_nct>) as.data.frame(<psychnet_nct>) print(<psychnet_nct>) plot(<psychnet_nct>)
Compare the networks of two groups with a permutation test

Certificates

Optimality and structural checks that a fitted network is the solution of its estimator.

certificate()
Check that a fitted network solves its estimator
glasso_kkt()
Check that a precision matrix solves the graphical lasso
glm_lasso_kkt()
Check that coefficients solve a lasso-penalized regression
ggm_support_kkt()
Check that a precision matrix is the maximum-likelihood network on a graph
lmg_certificate()
Check the decomposition of a relative-importance network
tmfg_certificate()
Check that a network has the structure of a TMFG

Result objects

plot(<psychnet>) `$`(<psychnet>) print(<psychnet>) as.data.frame(<psychnet>) summary(<psychnet>)
Fitted psychometric network

Crosswalk

Arguments of qgraph, bootnet, IsingFit and mgm mapped to psychnets.

net_crosswalk()
Map the arguments of established network packages to psychnets
